newsitem.title: UK: Brady market quiet as dealers digest recent rally.
newsitem.headline: Brady market quiet as dealers digest recent rally.

text.p: The Brady bond market was subdued on Wednesday as participants digested the strong overnight rally in New York and the imminent U.S. GDP data, dealers said.
"Its pretty quiet after what happened yesterday after the strong rally on the good U.S. data," a dealer said.
"This morning nothing has really happened and everyone is waiting for the GDP number and the jobless claims on Thursday," he added.

A spectacular rally in the U.S. Treasury and stock market sent Brady bond prices soaring on Tuesday as market sentiment turned more positive after bond friendly data eased inflation fears, market sources in New York said.
Dealers said Argentina, Brazil and Venezuela performed particularly well, with spreads significantly narrowing.
Argentine FRBs were unchanged from the close at 91-3/4 while the country's par bonds were down 1/2 at 64-3/8 bid.
Mexican Pars were down 1/2 at 72 bid and the country's discount bonds were 1/4 down at 88-1/4 bid.
Bulgaria FLRB were 1/2 down at 47 bid.
"We expect there to be some activity when New York opens later," another dealer said.
"We could see some profit-taking although the rally could also extend," he added.
